context: Wrap the create_schema call in _setup_fresh_database_phases with the same recording connection used for the post-load phases (or initialize the ledger before schema creation and pass the recorder through). Confirm no statement is recorded twice when a platform also records DDL itself.
description:
chatgpt-codex-connector review finding on merged PR #1261 (P1, benchbox/platforms/base/adapter.py:790). Deferred from the PR-review sweep in PR #1292 because it is an adapter-lifecycle change affecting exported evidence and needs live verification on a schema-tuned platform; tracked in GitHub issue #1293.

For platforms whose tuning is rendered into CREATE TABLE during schema creation, the ledger is initialized in the adapter but _setup_fresh_database_phases still calls create_schema with the RAW connection, before any DDL-recording wrapper is in play. ClickHouse injects tuned PARTITION BY / ORDER BY clauses in create_schema and executes them directly, so a run whose physical tuning is ONLY schema DDL can export noop / no applied_ledger_hash even though the database was genuinely tuned.
Thread: https://github.com/joeharris76/BenchBox/pull/1261#discussion_r3630131939

Related: clickhouse-applied-ledger-fidelity-20260724 covers the ClickHouse-side recording; this item covers the base-adapter lifecycle seam. Sequence them to avoid double-recording the same DDL.

anti_patterns.instead: keep the change in the adapter lifecycle seam
anti_patterns.why: it is a CODEOWNERS soundness path and would withhold auto-merge

anti_patterns.dont: record the same CREATE TABLE from both the base wrapper and the platform mixin
anti_patterns.instead: pick one owner per statement and assert single-recording in a test
anti_patterns.why: duplicate statements change the order-sensitive applied_ledger_hash

preserves.behavior: No statement is recorded twice when a platform already records its own schema DDL
Platforms with no schema-phase tuning export exactly the ledger they do today

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/platforms/ tests/unit/core/tuning/ -q

work_units.evidence: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/core/tuning/test_requested_vs_applied_capture.py tests/unit/platforms/test_clickhouse_introspection.py -q (27 passed); uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/platforms/ tests/unit/core/tuning/ -q (8846 passed)
work_units.summary: Route create_schema in _setup_fresh_database_phases through the DDL-recording connection so schema-phase tuning DDL enters the ledger

work_units.evidence: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/platforms/test_clickhouse_introspection.py::TestTunedSortKeyFold::test_schema_phase_tuning_exports_hash_without_duplicate_ddl -q (passed; local fake ClickHouse lifecycle proves one schema DDL ledger record and non-null applied_ledger_hash; no live cloud run authorized)
work_units.summary: Prove on ClickHouse (schema-DDL-only tuning) that the run exports a real applied_ledger_hash instead of noop, with no duplicated statements
